subject: Tomorrow is Swamiji's Birthday – Celebrate with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we celebrate the birthday of Swami Kriyananda (J. Donald Walters), the direct disciple of Paramhansa Yogananda who founded Ananda and dedicated his life to sharing Master's teachings.

Swamiji was a prolific writer, composer, and teacher who helped make Master's teachings accessible to thousands. His vision of intentional communities and his emphasis on joy, service, and attunement continue to inspire the Ananda community worldwide.

As we honor Swamiji's birth, let us reflect on his teachings and the legacy he left for all seekers.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this day bring you closer to Swamiji's teachings and the path of joy.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
